## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're experiencing.

Example: "I need to monitor the heat recovery efficiency, but this sensor is not available."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Use Case

Explain how you would use this feature and why it's valuable.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

## Additional Information

### Vallox Model
Which Vallox model(s) should this feature support?

### Protocol Details
If you have information about relevant RS485 registers, include them here:

| Register | Name | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| 0x?? | | |

### References

- Link to relevant documentation
- Link to FHEM wiki if applicable
- Screenshots or diagrams

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues/feature requests
- [ ] This feature is not already available in the integration
- [ ] This feature is technically feasible (within RS485 protocol capabilities)
